note: Declared external-client-identity -> (tenant, agent, role) bindings for the chat front door (issue #505, ADR-0023). The client's own user table is advisory, never authoritative: an identity absent from this list is REFUSED, never defaulted to a tenant. This file carries no secret material - no key, token, password or credential of any kind lives here (GR-6); the credential signing key comes from the deployment environment.
